title: The Hole in the Sky
text: There is a hole in the sky above the road, a ragged black wound in the grey, and the wind blows up into it. Something on the other side is looking down. You can feel it. An eye the size of a field, patient, curious, and paying attention to you.

options.label: The bravest looks back at the eye, and refuses to look away.

outcomes.text: It blinks first. Nobody believes it at first, but it did.
It does not blink. It never will. They can still feel it, every day, everywhere.

options.label: Cover your eyes and walk, and do not let it see your faces.

outcomes.text: You walk blind for a mile, and feel it watching every step.

options.label: Signal it. If it wants to look, let it see you.

outcomes.text: Something comes down, and it has been wanting to for a long time.
